rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING ARTICLES 333 AND 334 AND AMENDING ARTICLE 344 OF ACT 3815, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AND DEFINING THE CRIME OF MARITAL INFIDELITY
rows.abstract: Defines "marital infidelity" as an act committed by any person who has carnal knowledge with a person other than this wife or her husband, or who shall keep a mistress or a lover in a conjugal dwelling, or cohabits in any other place with another, comporting themselves as spouses when in thruth they are not. Explains, further, that marital infidelity is likewise committed by a person who cohabits with a married man or woman knowing him or her to be married.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7202, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE SUGAR RESTITUTION LAW, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES(SUGAR PLANTERS AND MILLERS)
rows.abstract: Provides that whatever amount or PROPERTIES recovered by the government through the Presidential Commission on Good Government (PCGG) or any other agency TRANSFERRED AND CEDED TO THE GOVERMENT UNDER THE COMPROMISE AGREEMENTS ENTERED INTO BY THE PCGGAND ROBERTO S. BENEDICTO shall be used to compensate all sugar PLANTERS AND MILLERS from Crop Year 1974-1975 up to and including Crop Year 1984-1985 on a pro rata basis. Directs the PCGG to turn over to the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) allfunds and assets already recovered which in turn shall be distributed as soon as possible to the sugar planters and millers  on a pro rata basis and to the sugar producers, ten (10%) percent of which shall be allocated to labor.
